posts.text:
Take care of yourself.
Tend to your own spirit.

In a world that tries to exhaust you,
it is an act of resistance.

In a world that tells you you’re not enough,
it is an act of defiance.

And in a world that needs more love, 
it is an act of generosity

because when you nurture your own soul, you don’t have less for others…

you have more.

Video

This is what happens
when we come together.

When we dare together.
When we build together.
When we believe together.

We rise.
We reach.
We surpass limitations.

Video

On Tax Day, imagine keeping more of what you earn. 

My Keep Your Pay Act makes the first $75,000 of household income tax-free for most working families—putting real money back in your pocket.

See how much you’d save with this tax calculator: policyengine.org/us/keep-you…

Trump’s proposed cuts to WIC will take food—fruits, vegetables, nutrition—from low-income mothers, infants, and children. These cuts are needlessly cruel, WIC is a lifeline. We must protect it.

Video

The Paramount–Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery merger threatens to give consumers fewer choices and have a chilling effect on the critical journalism Americans rely on. 

Although the majority has failed to hold a formal hearing scrutinizing this merger, I refuse to stay silent. Today, along with a group of my colleagues, we are holding a hearing to publicly examine these risks and fight for workers, artists, and the American people.

Kindness.
Connection.
Inclusion.

In a time when too many voices - from even the highest offices - trade in division and diminish the dignity of others…

May we be a reminder:

Grace still lives.
Decency still shows up.

That there are always those who 
Make space
See one another 
And honor every child’s joy.

Video

When we design our world with justice, access, and inclusion at the center, we don't just lift up the few—we lift up everyone.

Video

The American people do not want this war. 

They want a congress that does its job.

Video

Faith calls us to humility, not self-exaltation.
To service, not spectacle.
To reverence, not ego.

When anyone lifts themselves to the level of Christ, it is not just delusion - it is a degradation of something sacred and an insult to the faithful.

Video

Trump continued to insult, injure and disrespect others.

Video

Cardinal Tobin is right. ICE agents hiding their faces to terrorize communities is reckless and out of control. This violates our Constitution and is a cruel attack on dignity

Video

The best kind of winning doesn’t diminish others.
It dignifies them.
It reaches back, lifts up, and reminds us that greatness shared is greatness multiplied.

Video

Stand strong 
Stand together.

Video

Donald Trump is corrupt and does not care about law and order. He cares about personal profits and grifting and grabbing off of his office.

Video

The war in Iran is slamming our family farmers right as planting season hits. One-third of the world’s fertilizer moves through those waters — now shortages and skyrocketing prices threaten our food supply.

Video

Trump & Vance’s leadership continues to fail us.

We deserve better than this.

Video

Have a great Monday.

Video

ICE is reckless and out of control.

Her family says she was unlawfully detained by ICE for 5 months.
No crime. No reason. 

This cruelty must stop.

Video

Our national security experts have made it clear: Trump’s war in Iran has not resolved the fundamental issues that sparked this conflict.  

Trump’s reckless warmongering must stop.

Video

Thank you, Boss, for standing up for the soul of America, in these challenging times. 

No retreat. No surrender.

Video
